versions.changelog:
- Updates authentication environment variable and cache file names from PANGOLIN_TOKEN and ~/.pangolin_token to PANGOLIN_API_KEY and ~/.pangolin_api_key for consistency.
- Updates documentation (SKILL.md) to reflect the new variable and file names throughout setup and usage instructions.
- No changes to core usage, command-line options, or API behavior.

- Updated documentation to use "API Key" terminology instead of "Token" for Pangolin credentials.
- Clarified credential setup instructions and aligned variable names in the SKILL.md with current Pangolin dashboard terminology.
- No user-facing changes to behavior or APIs; this update is documentation-only.

Initial release of pangolinfo-ai-serp – Google search and AI Overview integration via Pangolin APIs.

- Search Google and retrieve AI Overviews, standard search results, or SERP screenshots using Pangolin.
- Supports both English and Chinese query prompts.
- Interactive authentication flow: guides users through Pangolin account setup and token caching.
- Secure credential handling; tokens cached for future use with no manual environment config needed.
- Handles multi-turn search conversations and regional/song mode options.
- Clear error handling for authentication, SSL, and credit exhaustion scenarios.
